description:
Join StikSMP 1.21.11-26.X — A Fair, Feature-Rich - Minecraft Server Experience!

Server IP: play.stiksmc.us

Bedrock Edition Address: bplay.stiksmc.us Bedrock Edition Port: 443

Welcome to StiksMC, a server built on fairness, fun, and a friendly community — not pay-to-win. Everything supporters get can be earned for free through gameplay! Whether you’re here for adventure, building, being peaceful or economy, there’s always something to do.

Core Features:

• Essential Commands: /back, /ender, /sethome, /skills, /jobs, /dback, /playerwarps, /chestshop

• Quests, Dungeons, Mob Arenas, and Daily Additions!

• Upgradeable Hoppers, Advanced Chests, and endless custom features

• Mature, respectful staff who listen and work daily to improve your experience

• Active, responsive community that values your feedback

What Makes Us Stand Out:

• Custom Armor & Enchants

• Collectible Plushies, Furniture, & Cosmetics

• Safe Land Claims with the Lands plugin

• Piñata Party Vote Events & Crates full of rewards

• Player-Driven Economy with shops, trades, and auction house

• Ranks with in-game perks (no real money needed)

• Dynamic Events, Leaderboards

• Separate Skills & Leveling Systems for deeper progression

We’re Fair. We’re Fun. We’re Community First.

Join a server that supports free-to-play players, offers constant updates, and truly values every player.
